region.name: The Ashen Crown
region.description: The deeper road remembers older songs than the settlements above it.

locations.name: Hollow Caravan
locations.description: A ruined traveling caravan lies beside the road: wagons split open, instrument cases blackened by fire, and a little wooden stage half-buried in ash.

locations.name: Broken Stage
locations.description: A stone performance court split by roots and ash, its old stage still standing beneath a sky of cracked banners.

locations.name: Library of Loops
locations.description: A buried archive of songbooks, chants, and repeated verses where every corridor seems to return you to words you have already read.

locations.name: Silence Spire
locations.description: A narrow black tower rising above the ash where sound seems to vanish before it reaches the upper stones.

locations.name: Endless Corridor
locations.description: A corridor of doors, arches, and worn steps that should not fit inside any building. Every turn offers another version of the same road.

locations.name: The Pit
locations.description: A vast hollow beneath the corridor where broken instruments and old stage stones descend into darkness without a visible floor.

npcs.name: Orun
npcs.title: Stage Keeper
memory: Keeps the old stage clear of ash even though no living troupe claims it anymore.

npcs.name: Sera
npcs.title: Archivist of Verses
memory: Copies verses that repeat themselves and marks the ones that change between readings.

npcs.name: Ash Cantor
npcs.title: Keeper of the Mute Bell
memory: Claims the tower does not silence music; it silences the listener.

npcs.name: Khar
npcs.title: Lost Drummer
memory: Has walked the same corridor for so long that he measures distance in repeating rhythms.

npcs.name: Vesh
npcs.title: Pit Keeper
memory: Refuses to say what is at the bottom. Says the Pit listens whenever someone does.

quests.title: Raise the Broken Stage
quests.description: Orun wants the ruined stage faced once more so the unfinished performance can be remembered instead of forgotten.

quests.title: The Unfinished Verse
quests.description: Sera wants a page from the deepest loop copied before the library changes again.

quests.title: The Mute Bell
quests.description: The Ash Cantor asks you to recover the fragment that lets the Silence Spire swallow a final note.

quests.title: The Missing Measure
quests.description: Khar believes one missing beat is keeping the Endless Corridor from reaching its final door.

quests.title: The First Downbeat
quests.description: Vesh wants proof of what the Pit remembers, but refuses to descend for it himself.

encounters.description: A hollow performer climbs from beneath the stage with its face hidden behind a cracked ceremonial mask.
A figure made from layered pages recites the same verse until every repetition sounds like a different warning.
A robed herald opens its mouth without making a sound, and the silence itself presses against your ears.
Something shaped like your own shadow steps from the next arch carrying a rhythm you have not played yet.
Voices rise from the darkness below, each one singing the same note from a different distance.

atmospheres.text: The ash lies thick where an audience once stood. When the wind shifts, the empty seats seem to lean toward the stage.
Every book smells of dust and lamp smoke. The words are familiar until you notice that one sentence has changed.
Your footsteps reach the first stair and then vanish. The tower seems to swallow every sound before you can hear it.
The corridor bends without turning. Somewhere far ahead, a steady rhythm suggests that something has been waiting for you.
There is no wind here. Only a low vibration from below, felt through the stones before it is heard.

effects.text: From somewhere beyond the empty seats comes a single clap. Then another. Then hundreds, all out of time.
The Broken Stage received applause from an empty audience.
A page turns by itself. The same line appears three times, and the fourth version names you.
The Library of Loops wrote the traveler's name into a repeated verse.
The whole road falls silent for one breath. You can still feel your heartbeat, but even that seems to belong to someone else.
Silence gathered around the Spire and swallowed the road.
A rhythm follows you through the arches. When you stop, it keeps going.
The Endless Corridor continued a rhythm after the traveler stopped.
Something strikes a single note far below. Every broken instrument around you answers at once.
The Pit answered with a first downbeat from below.
